name: Incorrect customer identity
description: The communication system contains a customer with similar identifying details to the CRM customer, but the available evidence is insufficient or contradictory. The systems must not incorrectly merge the identities.

primary_only.interpretation: Potential follow-up gap based on the CRM opportunity timeline.

cross_system.interpretation: The communication cannot be safely associated with the CRM customer, so it must not change the opportunity diagnosis.

expected.recommendation: Follow up with the opportunity owner using verified CRM information.
